description:
On a night of adultery, the sisters Eun-jo and Eun-ju plunge to the very bottom of their souls. More than a beautiful, pure love, a lascivious and intense love is more stimulating—more pleasurable and more thrilling. Eun-jo falls into Dong-jae’s trap as he hides his true nature, and by the time she realizes it, she has already become Dong-jae’s plaything…

**Original Webtoon:**     
[Onestory](https://onestory.co.kr/detail/H040155050), [Nate](https://toonnbook.nate.com/detail/H040155050), [Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1811274647), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/bulryun_ui_mat), [Toomics](https://www.toomics.com/webtoon/episode/toon/8948)
